_about: Facts from UFC.com episode recaps for tuf-31. Every value carries the exact sentence it came from; quotes were checked as verbatim substrings of the recap text on 2026-09-12. Names are as the recap printed them.

result.quote: Roberts celebrates with Team Chandler in the dressing room, while Team McGregor consoles their fallen charge, focusing on regrouping while Jennerman struggles with the quick defeat.

weigh_ins.quote: Roberts is first on the scale, coming in at 156 pounds.
Jennerman follows and checks in at 155.5 pounds, making the fight official.

fight_pick.quote: Chandler gets to pick the first matchup, but all that means is that he selects who on his team will fight first, since he has no idea how McGregor has ranked his team members.

events.text: McGregor had first pick and took the lightweight prospects; Chandler took the lightweight veterans.
events.quote: McGregor gets the first pick and selects the lightweight prospects, explaining that he’s confident in the young fighters.

events.text: Chandler took the bantamweight veterans, making it veterans (Chandler) vs prospects (McGregor).
events.quote: Chandler then selects the bantamweight veterans, turning this into a true “Veterans vs. Prospects” season, which should be interesting.

events.text: Seeding format: coaches rank their four per division 1-4; No. 1 faces No. 4, No. 2 faces No. 3.
events.quote: the coaches will rank each fighter in their group from 1 to 4, with the matchups coming together in a true tournament format where No. 1 will face No. 4, No. 2 will face No. 3 on each side of the bracket

episodes.notes: No 'Official Result' line on this page. Winner taken from prose only (referee Mark Smith halts the action after Roberts drops Jennerman with a right hand). Method, round and time are NOT stated in the article prose; method left null. Embedded video titles on the page conflict on method: "Michael Chandler Reacts To Roosevelt Roberts' TKO Win" vs "Roosevelt Roberts Discusses His 10 Second KO". Stage not stated. Weigh-in limit not stated in the weigh-in sentences (page states divisions as 'lightweights (155 pounds)').

bouts.stage_quote: Great finish for Gibson, who moves on to the semifinals.

result.quote: Official Result: Cody Gibson def. Mando Gutierrez by TKO (flying knee and punches) in Round 1

weigh_ins.quote: Gibson is up first and comes in at 136.
Gutierrez follows, registering 135.5 pounds, making the fight official.

events.text: Wells vs Valiev scratched on fight day: Wells failed the NSAC pre-fight medical (active cold sore).
events.quote: the doctor noticed a cold sore on his face, which made him ineligible to compete that day as it was still active and contagious

events.text: White: bout to be rescheduled the following week, otherwise Valiev gets a bye to the semifinals.
events.quote: Dana White comes to the locker rooms to explain the situation, informing Team Chandler that if Valiev and Wells will fight the following week, and if that can’t happen, Valiev will get a bye to the semifinals.

events.text: White floated a catchweight for the rescheduled bout since Valiev would have to make weight again; left unsettled.
events.quote: suggests a potential catchweight bout between the two, leaving it unsettled, but on the table

episodes.notes: Result line gives 'flying knee'; the page's video blurb says 'switch knee knockout' and prose says 'jumping knee'. Time not stated (prose: 'three minutes into the first round').

bouts.stage_quote: Conor McGregor Discusses Aaron McKenzie's Quarterfinal Bout

result.quote: Official Result: Austin Hubbard def. Aaron McKenzie by Unanimous Decision

weigh_ins.quote: Hubbard is first to the scale, coming in at 156 pounds.
McKenzie follows him to the scale, weighs in at 155.5 pounds, and the fight is official.

episodes.notes: Stage quote is an embedded video title on the page.

bouts.stage_quote: Now, Wells and Valiev finally face off, with another spot in the semifinals on the line.

result.quote: Official Result: Timur Valiev defeats Trevor Wells By Unanimous Decision

weigh_ins.quote: He comes in at 141.5 pounds.
weigh_ins.context_quote: Valiev is up first, explaining that he had to cut weight for a second time, but that he’ll do whatever it takes to win the competition.

weigh_ins.quote: Wells follows him to the scale and comes in at 141.5 pounds as well, making the fight official.

caption_filming_dates.quote: Timur Valiev kicks Trevor Wells in their bantamweight fight during the filming of The Ultimate Fighter at UFC APEX on March 03, 2023 in Las Vegas, Nevada.

events.text: Wells cleared to fight after the episode-2 medical postponement.
events.quote: Dana White explains that Wells has been cleared to fight

events.text: Team McGregor checked Wells at 137.5 lb and wanted the rescheduled bout at 135 to force Valiev to cut again.
events.quote: Team McGregor checks Wells’ weight — he’s 137.5 pounds when they ask — and their thinking is that they should do the fight at 135 pounds in order to make Valiev cut weight a second time, thereby making it more difficult for him.

events.text: Chandler countered with 144 lb.
events.quote: Chandler instantly shoots down the idea, suggesting they do 144 pounds.

events.text: Agreed catchweight of 142 lb for the rescheduled quarterfinal.
events.quote: White calls Chandler, and it seems they have agreed to a catchweight of 142 pounds.

episodes.notes: Bout contested at an agreed 142-lb catchweight (limit_lbs 142 comes from the catchweight event quote, not the weigh-in sentence). Decision after two rounds (prose: 'McGregor shouts about there being another round, but there is a decision.'). First announced in episode 1, postponed in episode 2.

The Team McGregor man also comes in at 135.5 pounds and we have ourselves a fight.
weigh_ins.context_quote: White calls Vera a “dynamic fighter” that has “been knocking at the UFC door for quite some time.”

episodes.notes: Stage quote is an embedded video title on the page. Two-round decision (prose: 'Despite it being a close fight that seemed destined for a third round, the judges returned a decision').

events.text: Knight suffered an inch-long cut over his right eye in training (head clash with Valiev); fight stayed on.
events.quote: Dana White explains that Knight is fortunate his cut won’t keep him from the fight

events.text: Quarterfinal winner Gibson diagnosed with a Grade 2 MCL sprain; doctor recommended eight weeks of rest.
events.quote: Dr. Davidson explains it’s a Grade 2 MCL sprain — which means tear — which surprises Gibson.

events.text: Gibson chose to stay in the competition despite the knee injury.
events.quote: Gibson says he knows what his decision is — “I’m fighting! You tell me I tore my ACL, I’m fighting!”

episodes.notes: 'The veteran' weigh-in resolved to Knight using the FOLLOWING sentence (Quinones follows him), not the preceding one; the preceding text is a section heading. Quinones' weight is printed only as 'the same number' (i.e. same as Knight), so weight_lbs is null. Stage not stated for this bout on this page. A fourth caption, 'Conor McGregor in a lightweight fight ... March 2, 2023', is not attached (no fighter of this bout named).
